concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-getting-paid]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service guide for merchant proceeds to company balance/payout account, scheduled/on-demand routes, irreversible instrument deletion, regional priorities and TEST fixtures; separate from legacy Payout API.
warnings: SEPA wire cut-off example says 16:30 PM ET while table says 16:55 CET (raw lines 98–101, 139); do not infer one cut-off.
Principal flow is merchant/company proceeds, despite raw line 72 saying user's account; third-party payout guides are separate.
Raw line 236 excludes USD payouts to US bank accounts when the legal entity is in Canada or Hong Kong.

Raw line 219 instructs a numberAndBic cross-border instrument for the same bank account, while destination table lines 283–287 require IBAN in some locations, allow either in others, and require numberAndBic elsewhere; scope unresolved.
